title: Migration entry test coverage
text: One shared table-driven harness discovers every packaged entry, checks destructive serving floors, applies twice on empty booted and seeded current schemas, and re-proves standing invariants with the production retirement rules. Dedicated tests retain reachable data-change and refusal assertions. Retiring historical coverage requires accounting for known hosted, local and self-hosted installs. A baseline squash deletes dedicated tests with their entries; a source check refuses references to absent entry modules or loader selectors. Migration-area impact selection includes both shared checks whenever an entry changes. Folded entries retain their digest and resolved serving floor in released_history_digests.json. Merge preflight accepts removing released scripts when their folded identities preserve the frozen history; live applied scripts still cannot change. Doctor and released-history checks compare folded digests without reading removed scripts. New databases stamp them without scripts; existing databases missing any folded name, including empty pre-ledger databases, must upgrade through a build carrying the scripts first.
